messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a hands-on lab + refapp codewalk for the OSS refapp launch (goal: drive dev signups + benchmark narrative). Proposed format: 45m live demo (walk through refapp + one perf-tuning step) + 30m guided lab (Codespaces / Cloud shell). Need: landing page + signup form, pre-baked lab env, benchmark scripts + sample numbers. Who can own content, benchmark run, and lead routing? :rocket:
Sam: Love it. Suggest framing as 'zero -> deployable refapp in 20 mins' then show one optimization (batching or quant). Benchmarks to surface: p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens. I can run benchmarks if infra is ready. Timeline: dry run 2 weeks before. Also let's prep 2–3 short clips for socials.
Leo: I can own lab infra. Plan: pre-configured Codespace image + a GCP/OCI cloud shell option, limit concurrent seats. For lead routing: recommend HubSpot form -> webhook -> Zapier OR direct webhook to our inbound endpoint. Example webhook payload we'll use: ```json
{"email":"{{email}}","name":"{{name}}","source":"refapp-lab","utm":"{{utm}}"}
``` Will add rate limits and seat TTL in the runner.
Rachel: Messaging note — audience = devs evaluating infra & cost. Lead with "deploy fast, save tokens" and include a tiny cost-savings calc in the blog post. I can draft blog + landing copy. Also propose a 1-question pre-event form to route enterprise vs self-serve leads. @Sam — can you help with a 2-line event blurb? :handshake:
OpsBot: Calendar created: "Hands-on RefApp Lab" — 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC. Invite posted to #marketing + #devrel. Registration: https://redwood.example/labs/register
Maya: Awesome, thanks all. Action items: Sam -> benchmark numbers + 2 social clips; Leo -> finalize Codespace image + webhook wiring; Rachel -> draft landing/blog and short survey; I'll coordinate dry run scheduling (target week of 2026-04-01) and make a simple lead routing doc for sales handoff. If anyone needs to swap tasks speak up, otherwise I'll spin a checklist and assign owners by EOD. :mega:
